tasks.short: Gather broadcast information at press conferences.

steps.what: Attend the actual press conference, listen critically and ask relevant questions
Write and check source-linked conference notes for later broadcast preparation

loop.purpose: Organise actual conference content into working notes
loop.input: permitted actual recording or announcer dictation with source markers
loop.output: draft source-linked conference notes with uncertainties
loop.check: Announcer checks speaker attribution, quotation accuracy, context, unanswered questions and omitted qualifications against actual source
loop.stop: No permitted source, uncertain quote or two failed revisions requires manual notes
loop.why_not_simpler: Native recording bookmarks first; variable spoken content needs bounded note drafting

steps.what: Save the checked final conference notes

tasks.design: Test native {DOCS} recording bookmarks and note fields first, then draft working notes from actual permitted source content. Announcer attends, questions and checks meaning personally; notes are not automatically published or broadcast.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning actual conference answers into accurate source-linked notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting from actual recordings or dictation.
tasks.still_hard: Attribution, misleading statements and missing context.
tasks.human_edge: Ask useful questions and distinguish claims from established facts.
tasks.altitude: Less note composition; reporting judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting from permitted actual conference recordings can organise working notes subject to attribution and meaning checks.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual conference attendance and notes already made for broadcast preparation; no broadcast release. Conference organiser supplies actual event and permitted recording, or announcer supplies own dictation in s2. Source preparation, dictation and correction remain within70 percent of note time; no free transcript. Missing or restricted recording requires manual notes.

Native first, existing note automation yields zero. Provisional note19 is actual working-note effort, not added reporting administration. Attendance80 unchanged, save1 retained. Ordinary note writing/checking supplies gate without extra self-approval. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Actual recording permission and working-note effort
research_questions: Can notes preserve attribution and distinguish unanswered questions from answers?

incremental.description: Maintain recording access and audit note attribution

approvals.approved_version: s2 complete checked final conference notes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional note19 reduced30 percent saves5.7 minus1 upkeep=4.7; half permitted eligible conferences gives1.85. Actual attendance80 and save1 unchanged.

steps.what: Inspect actual music assets and reconcile catalogue identifiers and supplied metadata
Choose meaningful music categories and resolve ambiguous duplicates and versions
Populate music-library fields and apply the selected category and naming rules
Check complete final catalogue changes against actual assets and selected classifications
Commit the checked final music-catalogue updates

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} music-library metadata imports and batch field mapping. Announcer decides ambiguous identities and useful categories and checks the exact final update batch before commit; no automatic playlist publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated metadata transfer and catalogue field entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native music-library batch import and naming rules.
tasks.still_hard: Duplicate recordings, edits, unreliable metadata and meaningful categorisation.
tasks.human_edge: Know which recording and category are actually appropriate for the station.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated catalogue entry; curation unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native music-library imports and batch field rules reduce repeated catalogue entry without resolving musical identity or making curation choices.

assumptions: Boundary is actual library organisation through catalogue commit. Music supplier supplies actual file, title, artist, version and identifiers; existing catalogue supplies asset IDs. Announcer reconciles missing metadata in s1, selects ambiguous identity/category in s2 and enters unsupported fields manually in s3. No free genre labels or assumed broadcast rights; missing rights remain unresolved and do not permit airplay.

Native first; existing imports yield zero. Provisional source25 and entry25 are actual manual transfers only; curation35 and full-batch QA14 unchanged. Commit1 fully retained; exact final batch approved only after it exists. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Current library import support and metadata completeness
research_questions: Can native mappings distinguish versions without overwriting manual curation?

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final catalogue update batch and target library

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional source25 reduced40 percent saves10 and entry25 reduced60 percent saves15 minus1 upkeep=24. Half eligible asset batches gives11.5; curation35, final QA14 and commit1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Discuss topics with viewers or listeners by telephone.

steps.what: Listen to the actual caller and discuss the topic, questions and differing views
Enter and check actual caller topic and required follow-up in the existing call log

tasks.design: Use the existing {TELEPHONY} call handling and {OTHER} broadcast call-log fields. Actual discussion and the brief topic/follow-up entry stay human; no unconfigured clerical step or useful model loop is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: No repeated unconfigured work identified beyond the actual short log entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native call-log fields already handle the record.
tasks.still_hard: Live listening, uncertainty and difficult caller interactions.
tasks.human_edge: Respond fairly and keep a thoughtful conversation.
tasks.altitude: No change to workload or conversation responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing broadcast call-log fields can already capture a short topic and follow-up; they do not replace listener conversation.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual telephone discussion and its existing log entry, not broadcast transmission or producer screening. Caller supplies actual topic; announcer captures actual summary and follow-up in s2. Missing identity is not inferred; no compulsory new report or transcript is invented.

Native first found existing fields sufficient. Actual writing5 and save1 separated before zero; all labour retained. No configuration change means zero upkeep justified. Shares provisional, not measured. Existing transmission by broadcast operations is not removed announcer work and receives no saving.
unknowns: Actual caller-log practice and current native fields
research_questions: Is there any clerical repetition beyond the actual short native log entry?

incremental.description: No new component or configuration to maintain

approvals.approved_version: s2 complete checked actual caller-log entry

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All provisional100 units retained: actual conversation94, actual log writing5 and save1. Existing native fields need no change, zero upkeep and zero new saving.

steps.what: Read actual topic sources, panel brief and participant context
Moderate the actual panel, balance contributions and pursue relevant follow-up questions
Write and check actual programme notes and follow-up points after discussion

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} topic-source and panel-brief views. Keep actual source reading, moderation and programme-note writing human; retrieval improvements do not write questions or replace live panel judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation among actual topic and participant sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source collections and revision links.
tasks.still_hard: Live balance, conflicting claims and useful follow-up questions.
tasks.human_edge: Manage an informed, fair discussion as it unfolds.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; moderation responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source collections reduce preparation navigation without replacing source reading or panel moderation.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual moderation preparation, discussion and own existing programme notes. Producer supplies actual panel brief and participant identifiers; source publishers actual documents and dates. Announcer retrieves and verifies missing context in s1; source reading remains within75 percent. Notes in s3 use actual discussion only, never planned attendance or presumed agreement.

No added note approval; normal writing/checking gates save. Broadcast transmission is actual operations work, not removed focal labour. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Actual source-navigation burden and existing note practice
research_questions: Can native brief views expose source revisions without hiding opposing evidence?
